text:
maria: Quick heads-up — Brightline flagged for renewal risk. Usage down ~45% last 30d, support tickets about latency. Thinking we run a short "retention ladder" play: triage -> quick wins -> targeted credit + enablement -> downgrade ladder if needed. Thoughts?
trent: Agree. Can we get activation metrics and top 3 failing flows?
alex: I pulled their console heatmap, main pain is nightly batch reruns causing timeouts. Also their team tried a local model swap last week (per notes).
jess: Happy to lead enablement. I can do a 30m "how to optimize prompts + routing" session and share a one-pager. When do we want to offer credits vs feature-limited downgrade?
maria: Ideal timeline: immediate triage (today), enablement call within 2 business days, follow-up offer within 7 days if no improvement. Credits only if we can tie to measurable activation uplift.
samir: I'll run the triage checklist now. Sending quick checklist snippet:```- confirm active routes and model pins
- check token/unit usage by route last 30d
- search for error spikes or fallback events
- verify batching config and cache hit-rate
- note recent infra changes (deploys/region swap)```
trent: Good checklist. Add "customer sentiment" — recent CS tickets + NPS note.
retention-bot: Created playbook card #CS-4821 for Brightline retention ladder. Assignee: jess. Due: 1766151589.
maria: Drafting outbound cadence. Sharing email + slack touch templates:```Hi <Name>,

Wanted to check in — we saw Brightline's usage dip and a few latency reports. We'd love to run a quick 30m session to walk through ops fixes that typically recover throughput. Can we do Wed or Thu?

If helpful, we can also provision a one-off credit tied to a config change and measure impact.

Best,
Maria (CS)```
jess: I'll send that after I confirm availability. Also prepping the enablement deck and 3 micro-tasks for their engineers.
alex: From infra: a short-term mitigation is to bump batch_size to 8 for their longest route and enable KV prefix caching. Should reduce tail latency.
maria: OK action items: samir — finish triage by EOD, jess — schedule session and send email, alex — stage mitigation config & a rollback plan, trent — prepare renewal notes for AE.
samir: Triage done: found 27% cache miss rate and 3 fallback events tied to model overload. Uploaded logs to /shared/brightline/triage.
jess: Session scheduled Thu 10am PT. Sent the email.
trent: AE looped in and proposing a 2-week "downgrade ladder" if no uplift: 1) reduced seat tier with preserved core features + 2) self-serve credit; 2) next step feature-limited plan; escalate to offboarding only after 30 days no recovery.
maria: Let's avoid hard downgrade if possible. Use the ladder as a safety net and timebox interventions. We'll track weekly: key metric = route tokens/day and successful request rate.
retention-bot: Weekly retention check created for CS-4821. Next check: 1766155189.
alex: Deployed the batch_size bump as a canary for Brightline — monitoring. ETA for metrics shift: 1-2 hours.
samir: Early signal: p95 dropped from 1.2s -> 0.6s on the canary route. Good sign.
jess: I'll include that in the enablement call as "quick win" slides.
maria: Great work team. If we see >20% usage rebound by next check, we pull back downgrade ladder. Otherwise we proceed with the staged downgrade offer + targeted credit tied to a specific config change.
trent: Note for playbook doc: include a small decision tree and the canned email + enablement checklist. I can draft the doc after the next check. :thumbsup:
